name: Muhammad Ishaq Khan
tagline: Code running in VS Code and Flutter. Building AI-powered dev tools, secure systems, and production apps at ELTE.
about: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE) in Budapest, building backbencher.cc — an AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes codebases into a queryable knowledge graph with 25+ AI-powered tools.

I've contributed to VS Code (performance optimization) and Flutter (security hardening), and built ProxiCall — a production Flutter super-app with Stripe payments, geo-fencing, and 32-language translation. My BSc thesis on ML-based phishing detection achieved 96.45% accuracy.

mobile: Firebase SDK (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions, Messaging)

projects.name: backbencher.cc (bb)
projects.description: My primary project — an open-core AST-native code intelligence platform that indexes entire codebases into a local SQLite knowledge graph. Ships with 25+ AI-powered brain tools for semantic search, call-graph traversal, AST-precise refactoring, architectural pattern detection, cross-language migration, and security scanning across 40+ languages.
highlights: 25+ brain tools (bb_search, bb_trace, bb_refactor, bb_security, bb_migrate)
Offline semantic search with word vectors
Beats Copilot on compiler-level code reasoning (benchmarked)
